name: HubSpot Duplicate Company Fuzzy Matcher (weekly audit)

parameters.content:
## HubSpot duplicate company fuzzy matcher
Read-only weekly audit. Finds likely duplicate companies (legal suffixes, sub-domains, typos) and sends one consolidated review queue to Slack and/or Notion.

**Safe by default:** `DRY_RUN` and `SANDBOX_MODE` are true unless the env var is exactly `false`.

**Env vars:** HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID, DRY_RUN, SANDBOX_MODE, SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, NOTIFY_TARGETS, MAX_COMPANIES, MAX_BLOCK_SIZE.

Requires `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`. Code nodes are generated from `src/` — edit there and rebuild.
